渠道组需要桌面端本地引擎；浏览器预览不执行模拟或保存。: Channel groups require the desktop engine. Browser previews cannot simulate or save.
桌面端未确认离线隔离或计费暂停，渠道组操作已停止。: The desktop engine did not confirm offline isolation and the billing hold. Channel group operations have stopped.
桌面渠道组接口与当前前端不匹配，请更新桌面端后重试。: The desktop channel group interface does not match this frontend. Update the desktop app and retry.
当前桌面版本尚未提供渠道组命令。: This desktop version does not provide channel group commands yet.
渠道组或共享项目预算已被其他操作修改。请保留草稿，刷新后重新编辑。: The group or shared project budget was changed elsewhere. Keep a copy of your draft, then refresh and edit again.
计数、时间和金额必须是可精确表示的非负整数。: Counts, timestamps, and amounts must be nonnegative, safely representable integers.
渠道组操作失败，草稿已保留。: The channel group operation failed. Your draft is retained.
组与渠道 ID 须为 1–128 个 ASCII 字母、数字、点、下划线或连字符: Group and channel IDs must contain 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores, or hyphens.
配置修订号无效，请刷新后重新编辑。: The configuration revision is invalid. Refresh and edit again.
配置最多包含 64 个组、128 个项目和 512 个渠道。: A configuration supports up to 64 groups, 128 projects, and 512 channels.
渠道 ID 已存在，请为每个引用使用不同 ID。: This channel ID already exists. Use a different ID for each reference.
账号引用无效，请重新选择。: The account reference is invalid. Select it again.
请填写组名，最多 256 字节且不含控制字符。: Enter a group name of up to 256 bytes with no control characters.
模型别名须为 1–128 个字母、数字、点、下划线或连字符。: The model alias must contain 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores, or hyphens.
项目 ID 须为 1–128 个字母、数字、点、下划线或连字符。: The project ID must contain 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores, or hyphens.
至少添加一个渠道引用。: Add at least one channel reference.
每个渠道组最多包含 32 个渠道。: A group supports up to 32 channels.
请填写上游模型 ID，最多 256 字节且不含控制字符。: Enter an upstream model ID of up to 256 bytes with no control characters.
渠道必须引用上游模型，不能嵌套渠道组。: Channels must reference upstream models. Nested channel groups are not supported.
额度池 ID 须为 1–128 个字母、数字、点、下划线或连字符。: The quota pool ID must contain 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores, or hyphens.
最大退避不能小于限流冷却时间。: Maximum backoff must be at least the rate-limit cooldown.
在同优先级的可用渠道间依次轮转。: Rotate through eligible channels at the same priority.
优先有已知剩余额度的渠道；缺少额度证据时保持未知。: Prefer channels with known remaining quota. Missing quota evidence stays unknown.
按渠道权重分配同优先级的选择机会。: Distribute selections by channel weight within the same priority.
比较当前预留并发与渠道并发上限。: Compare concurrent reservations with channel concurrency limits.
参考本地观测延迟；没有观测的渠道保留未知状态。: Use locally observed latency. Channels without observations remain unknown.
账号未声明支持该模型: Account does not declare support for this model
此供应商需要明确选择账号: Select an explicit account for this provider
Token 窗口包含用量未知的请求: Token window includes requests with unknown usage
渠道存在金额未知的请求: Channel has requests with unknown cost
共享项目存在金额未知的请求: Shared project has requests with unknown cost
上游结果未知，采用失败冷却: Upstream outcome unknown; failure cooldown applied
预算检查需要明确的预留金额: Budget checks require a known cost reservation
账本存在金额未知的请求: Ledger contains requests with unknown cost
有状态请求缺少会话标识: Stateful request has no session identity
相同来源的渠道按共享额度保守处理。: Channels with the same origin conservatively share quota.
额度关系未知，按共享额度保守处理。: The quota relationship is unknown; quota is conservatively shared.
账号用量按供应商级账本保守计算，无法归属到具体渠道。: Account usage is conservatively based on the provider ledger and cannot be attributed to a specific channel.
历史记录属于供应商，不能归因到渠道或渠道组。: History is scoped to providers and cannot be attributed to a channel or group.
路由计数来自回放与模拟，不是实时请求计数。: Routing counters come from replay and simulation, not live requests.
superapi 525 计费问题尚未解决，计费测试已暂停，实时派发已禁用。: The superapi 525 billing issue is unresolved. Billing tests are paused and live dispatch is disabled.
健康状态只回放最近 2,048 条事件；账本用量包含全部已记录请求。: Health replays only the latest 2,048 events. Ledger usage includes all recorded requests.
历史记录不含响应头，限流恢复时间使用配置的冷却策略。: Recorded headers are unavailable. Rate-limit recovery uses the configured cooldown policy.
虚拟模型只供本地试点识别，尚未接入实时路由。: The virtual model identifies this local pilot and is not connected to live routing.
在离线试点中启用此组: Enable this group in the offline pilot
相同项目 ID 的组共享一份日预算；修改策略会影响这些组。金额单位为整数 μUS: Groups with the same project ID share one daily budget. Policy changes affect those groups. Amounts are integer μUSD; 1 USD = 1,000,000 μUSD.
留空表示不关联项目；输入已有 ID 会读取其当前预算策略。: Leave blank for no project. Enter an existing ID to load its current budget policy.
留空为未设置上限；0 表示零预算。: Leave blank for no cap. Enter 0 for a zero budget.
此项目当前没有其他渠道组。: No other channel groups currently use this project.
仅引用已有供应商、账号和模型。这里只读取账号元数据。: Reference existing providers, accounts, and models. Only account metadata is read here.
限制、权重、优先级与额度共享: Limits, weight, priority, and quota sharing
优先级数字越小越先选；限制留空为未设置，不代表上游剩余额度。: Lower priority numbers are selected first. Blank limits mean no configured cap, not remaining upstream quota.
额度共享关系由用户声明，未验证独立性；不同账号或供应商名称不构成独立额度证据。: Quota relationships are user declarations; independence is not verified. Different account or provider names are not evidence of independent quota.
健康与路由计数来自本地回放或模拟；供应商历史可影响多个引用渠道，不能据此判断实时: Health and routing counters come from local replay or simulation. Provider history can affect multiple channel references and does not establish live availability.
查看引用、限制与回放计数: View references, limits, and replay counters
以下窗口计数由回放和合成预留产生，不代表实时吞吐。共享池计数不能按渠道相加。: These window counters come from replay and synthetic reservations, not live throughput. Do not add shared-pool counters across channels.
每个供应商只展示一次，包含其全部已记录请求。它们不属于某个渠道或渠道组；未知用量: Each provider appears once with all its recorded requests. These records are not attributed to a channel or group; unknown usage and cost remain unknown.
固定输入：6 条合成预留，每秒 1 条，每条 128 Token、1,000 μ: Fixed input: 6 synthetic reservations, one per second, each for 128 tokens and 1,000 μUSD. Reservations remain pending through the trial; no model completion is generated.
同一快照与事件选择生成相同输入；本地账本或账号元数据变化可能改变选择结果。整个试: The same snapshot and event selection produce the same input. Changes to the local ledger or account metadata may change selections. The trial sends no network, model, or probe requests.
可直接运行固定模拟，也可先读取供应商级记录并选择回放事件。: Run the fixed simulation directly, or load provider records and select events to replay first.
最多读取 50 条供应商级记录。选中事件会影响同供应商的多个渠道，记录本身没有渠: Load up to 50 provider records. Selected events can affect multiple channels of that provider; the records have no channel attribution.
暂无可回放的本地记录。仍可运行固定模拟。: No local records are available for replay. You can still run the fixed simulation.
供应商级历史事件，可选用于离线回放: Provider history events available for offline replay
查看模拟后的状态与预留: View state and reservations after simulation
账号元数据读取失败；现有引用会保留，可刷新后重试。: Account metadata could not be loaded. Existing references are retained; refresh to retry.
渠道组已在离线试点中停用。: Channel group disabled in the offline pilot.
渠道组已在离线试点中启用。: Channel group enabled in the offline pilot.
将供应商、账号与上游模型组合为虚拟模型，在本地验证选择策略。: Combine provider, account, and upstream model references into a virtual model to test selection strategies locally.
启用仅参与本地选择与模拟，尚未接入实时路由。superapi 计费测试保持暂停。: Enabled groups participate in local selection and simulation only. Live routing is not connected. superapi billing tests remain paused.
浏览器预览未连接本地引擎，无法读取组配置、保存或运行模拟。这里不会生成示例引擎结: This browser preview has no local engine. It cannot read group configuration, save, or simulate. No sample engine results are generated here.
供应商目录读取失败；刷新供应商目录后再编辑渠道引用。: The provider directory could not be loaded. Refresh it before editing channel references.
从轮询开始，添加已有供应商的模型引用，再运行固定输入的离线模拟。: Start with round robin, add model references from existing providers, then run an offline simulation with fixed inputs.
未保存的渠道与共享项目预算修改将丢弃，已保存配置不会改变。: Unsaved channel and shared project budget changes will be discarded. Saved configuration will remain unchanged.
